column1: # Validation vectors of the IPv4 settings, shared by the firmware and the TypeScript client.
# The firmware service (components/network_settings) decides, and tests/network_settings/validation.c
# checks every line. web/client/test/ipv4-vectors.test.ts checks the same lines against the client's
# checks, mapping the client's own codes: not_ipv4 is bad_request, and gateway_not_usable is
# gateway_outside_subnet. Columns, separated by one tab: address, prefix length, gateway or -, and the
# expected answer: ok, bad_request (an address that is not a dotted quad), or the findings in order as
# field:code separated by commas. The prefix length is an integer, and a negative or huge one is not
